content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lawton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Lawton professionals in defense, energy, and government contracting often qualify through a combination of formal education and documented leadership hours. Review PMI's eligibility criteria before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course designed for working professionals. Our flexible schedule accommodates Lawton's project teams. You'll cover the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world case studies—all required to sit for the PMP exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your official PMP application directly to PMI, including your verified project experience and education documentation. Pay the associated exam fee to secure your testing eligibility and exam appointment window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice assessments, and instructor support to build confidence. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. Our cohort-based model keeps you accountable through final review sessions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible workshops and webinars to support your continued growth as a project management leader.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
